title: finding: the SIBLING advisory sink wiring in `AdapterProvider.tsx` is pinned by nothing — the same gap as #6969, on the adapter channel
body:
Found while implementing #6969 (the `useMetadata.ts` seam). Recording, not claiming — no assignee, `priority:*` is triage's.

## The gap

There are **two** parallel advisory wirings in app-shell, not one. #6969 covers the first; this is the second.

| channel | middle link | pinned? |
|---|---|---|
| `MetadataClient` (console metadata-admin clients) | `useMetadata.ts` hands the toast sink to `createConsoleMetadataClient` | ✅ now pinned by #6969 |
| `ObjectStackAdapter` (the adapter every data surface uses) | `AdapterProvider.tsx` subscribes `a.onSaveAdvisory(...)` and calls `emitSaveAdvisories` | ⛔ **nothing** |

The second one is the wiring #4237 built. Both ends of ITS chain are pinned too — the adapter's emitter in `packages/data-objectstack/src/onSaveAdvisory.test.ts`, the renderer in `saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts` — and, exactly as in #6969, nothing asserts the two are connected.

## Measurement (grep, with a control — not an ablation)

Stated plainly so the next reader knows what was and was not measured. This is a grep result, not the green-through-ablation that #6969 carried:

- suites naming `AdapterProvider`: **40**
- of those, naming `dvisor` (matches advisory/advisories/Advisory): **1**
- CONTROL, of those, naming `expect`: **40/40** — so the query is live, and the 1 above is a reading rather than a dead zero

The single hit is `packages/app-shell/src/services/MetadataService.saveAdvisories.test.ts`, and its own docstring says it does not close this gap:

> `AdapterProvider` is what wires the last two links in the real app; the sink is handed over here instead of mounting a toaster, exactly as `saveAdvisoryToast.test.ts` does, so nothing depends on module mocking.

⇒ the subscription in `AdapterProvider.tsx` (the `a.onSaveAdvisory` call and the `emitSaveAdvisories` inside it, plus its unsubscribe) is traversed by no test.

## What a fix looks like

The same shape #6969 landed, one channel over: mount the real provider, have the real adapter emit, assert the sink receives it. ⛔ Not a bigger renderer test and ⛔ not a bigger adapter test — both ends are already covered.

⚠️ Worth re-measuring before claiming, same as #6969: this was measured by grep, so an ablation on `AdapterProvider.tsx` is the leg that actually settles it.

## Related

- **#6969** — the same gap on the `MetadataClient` channel; its pin is the template
- **#4237** — the card that built this adapter wiring
- **#4133** / **#4236** — the save door the shape is inherited from
